CustomField.description: Internal, rep-supplied deal context: discovery notes, call summaries, anything the rep knows that the prospect's assessment answers do not say. Read by the readout assistant (GUS) as INPUT and never published — it is not part of Draft_Content__c or Approved_Content__c, so it never reaches the prospect-facing readout or the public link. Plain text, not HTML, precisely so that pasted client-supplied text can be handed to the model as data rather than as markup or instructions.
CustomField.label: Rep Context Notes
